description: Source file implementing cardinalities for Google Mock, including the Between(m, n) cardinality class and related functions.

classes.name: BetweenCardinalityImpl
classes.description: Implements the Between(m, n) cardinality with bounds checking and descriptive methods.

methods.name: DescribeTo
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the cardinality bounds.

methods.name: ConservativeLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of calls allowed.

methods.name: ConservativeUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of calls allowed.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedByCallCount
methods.description: Checks if a given call count satisfies the cardinality.

methods.name: IsSaturatedByCallCount
methods.description: Checks if a given call count saturates the cardinality.

methods.name: DescribeActualCallCountTo
methods.description: Describes the actual call count in human-readable form.
